spells.name: Animosity
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses an ability, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after that ability has been resolved.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ironsunz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Brutal Troof
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's attacks if it charged in the same turn or is in combat with an enemy unit that charged in the same turn.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ironsunz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Ironsunz^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Mork's Melee Miracle
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add the number of the current battle round to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ironsunz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Ironsunz^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6, subtracting the current battle round number from the roll.
